title: Trump's Supreme Court Wins and Losses
summary: The Supreme Court has struck down some of President Trump’s most consequential policies while upholding others that expand presidential authority. From birthright citizenship to tariffs and regulatory agencies, these rulings reveal how the Court defines the constitutional limits of executive power.

title: Debating Early Decision
